profile_text.body:
Boston Dynamics is a robotics company based in Waltham, Massachusetts. It was founded in 1992 and is organized as a for-profit public company. On its website the company describes itself as a leading global robotics company that builds practical robotics to tackle automation challenges and to change what people expect robots to do.

The site names Stretch, which it presents for case handling and warehouse automation, describing it as easy to deploy and flexible for keeping operations moving. It also offers white papers and eBooks on the development, implementation, and value of robots and automation solutions.

No lawsuits are recorded for the company. Its legal exposure record is in Massachusetts, with a count of 164. No MCP servers are listed.
